SPACE_BEFORE convention: each value is (this element's top - the previous listed element's bottom) / page height. For the three panel sub-elements it is measured against the figure group's top edge (panel b = 0.0) because (a) and (b) are horizontal neighbours and a literal predecessor gap would be negative; omitted entirely on page_number and on the watermark, which have no flow predecessor. INDENT convention: (element left - its column's left), full column = 0.0943, right column = 0.2872; reported as 0.0 for furniture that bleeds to the page edge (header band, corner device, folio tab, footer rule) since those are not column-aligned. FIELD NAMES: the brief's schema calls the typeface field 'font' while the runner's instruction calls it 'face'; both keys are written with identical values so neither consumer breaks. page_kind is likewise written both at the top level and inside 'page'. Nothing on this page was left unmeasured.
